docs.title: Home
docs.text: Commands Plus Plus      Minecraft Bedrock Command Extension Addon

docs.title: Welcome to The Commands++ Wiki
docs.text: The wiki is here to help out on Commands++ usage, as some commands can be more complex. It will include information, usage examples and tips on how to improve perfomance

docs.title: Contributing
docs.text:
We welcome contributions. If you have a suggestion or found a bug, please open an issue on our GitHub page. If you know how to code you can gladly open a pull request. Full AI code is discouraged and will likely be denied

More info on how to run the wiki locally under the wiki README.md
